title: Stirling PDF: free Adobe Acrobat alternative
caption:
Adobe Acrobat Pro charges $19.99/month to edit PDFs. Stirling PDF does it for free 📄

✅ Edit, merge, split and compress PDFs in one app
✅ Sign documents and black out private info with redact
✅ OCR turns scanned pages into searchable text
✅ Add passwords and watermarks, 60+ tools in total

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux
ℹ️ The desktop app is free for personal use and works offline. The text editor is still marked alpha, and team features like single sign-on are a separate paid plan

Comment "DOCS" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
